title: Practice: an exploration that writes down what it learns and can be resumed after a crash (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a finding is recorded once per area and fact in first seen order
cases.says: A finding is recorded once per area and fact, in first-seen order

cases.id: e1 the scratchpad groups findings under their area
cases.says: The scratchpad groups findings under their area

cases.id: e2 the manifest lists every agent with its state file and status and refuses bad input
cases.says: The manifest lists every agent with its state file and status, and refuses bad input

cases.id: e3 a finished agent with its state file is reused and not run again
cases.says: A finished agent with its state file is reused and not run again

cases.id: e4 a running or failed agent with a state file is resumed from it
cases.says: A running or failed agent with a state file is resumed from it

cases.id: e5 an agent whose state file is missing is restarted from scratch
cases.says: An agent whose state file is missing is restarted from scratch

cases.id: e6 the resume prompt carries the task and the state lines and nothing else
cases.says: The resume prompt carries the task and the state lines and nothing else

cases.id: e7 the compact command names what to keep
cases.says: The compact command names what to keep
